libs.note: BH-3481.3 live cost meter (2026-09-29). While a claude session runs, bin/lib/cost-live.sh reads its transcript every COST_LIVE_POLL_S seconds and every COST_LIVE_PUSH_S seconds offers ONE live row per (box, session) to POST /api/cost/live; the final cost_rows row settles it. For a build call the meter also asks tw_check_build and stops the session on a trip ($OUT.tripwire). After every cost row a boundary push spawns bin/cost-rows-push.sh detached, deduped on its lock. Applied by cost_live_on (lib_env_apply cost-live) once per bin/agent-call.sh process. Doc: docs/notes/2026-09-29-BH-3481.3-live-meter.md.

knobs.note: The switch. 0 (or no/off/false) = cost_live_on answers off (CL_OFF=knob), no meter runs, and the claude CLI runs in the foreground exactly as before. Read by cost_live_on as ${COST_LIVE:-1}.
How often the meter offers the running session's live row to the hub. Read by cost_live_meter as ${COST_LIVE_PUSH_S:-300}; a value that is not a positive integer reads as 300.

How often the meter reads the session transcript (bin/transcript-cost.sh) and asks the build tripwire. Read by cost_live_meter as ${COST_LIVE_POLL_S:-60}; a value that is not a positive integer reads as 60.

The age past which a reader treats a live row as stale: the value it passes as GET /api/cost/live?stale_s=. Read by cost_live_stale_s as ${COST_LIVE_STALE_S:-900}. Nothing calls cost_live_stale_s yet.

1 = after every cost row, bin/agent-call.sh spawns bin/cost-rows-push.sh detached (skipped when the cron lane's lock is held, or with no HARNESS_SECRET/JOBS_URL). 0 (or no/off/false) = rows wait for the 10-minute tick as before. Read by cost_live_boundary_push as ${COST_ROWS_PUSH_AT_BOUNDARY:-1}.
